utility.notes: Ridgecrest and the Indian Wells Valley are confirmed to be served exclusively by SCE for electricity (PG&E provides gas service to the area, but not electric). This was independently checked rather than assumed from Ridgecrest's location within Kern County, since most of this dataset's other Kern County cities (in the western San Joaquin Valley) are PG&E territory — Ridgecrest, in the eastern high-desert part of the county, is not.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025 and remains an active program per SGIP's own statewide announcements (most recently dated 2026-07-23). Administered across SCE's entire distribution territory, which includes Ridgecrest/Kern County.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Reused as a utility-level fact already established for other IOU-territory records this session: the CPUC-administered SGIP program applies uniformly across the named utility's entire distribution territory, directly verified via SGIP's own site (selfgenca.com) / the CPUC's own SGIP program page, including a program-status announcement as recent as 2026-07-23 confirming the program remains active.
